data.action: 执笔立于池边，墨点晕开
data.description: 【夕 · 水墨庭院】水墨晕染的画境庭院之中，青墨长发的龙女夕手持巨大的狼毫画笔立于莲池之畔。笔尖轻点水面瞬间化开千层墨浪，她眼角泪痣在淡墨中格外清冷妖娆——「天地不过方寸画卷，凡人庸庸碌碌皆入画中。喂，那边的呆子，站在那儿发什么愣？要是敢踩脏我的画卷，就把你画进石头里关上一百年。」
data.promptProse: Dusk grips the giant wolf-hair brush with both hands at the lotus pond and taps its ink-soaked tip into the water, watching layered black rings bloom outward. Ink-black qipao with teal clouds and gradient wide-sleeved robe move in the breeze beside her long hair. The medium view connects brush contact to lotus leaves receding through mist. Soft dawn light reveals ink edges and her unimpressed face, leaving darker ripples beneath the foliage.
data.title: 夕 · 水墨庭院
